findings.title: External Git registry/current-head durability is not hardened before dispatch
findings.detail: git helper invokes hash-object/update-ref with ambient defaults, and _append returns to source dispatch after update-ref without explicit durable reference/object barrier. core.fsync and core.fsyncMethod are unset in this environment. Installed Git2.54 manual documents default committed,-loose-object (not reference hardening) and macOS writeout-only fsyncMethod, which may lose data on system crash. External registry/head can therefore be lost or revert after dispatch; restored consistent old journal/custody snapshots could appear current, or lost singleton permit fresh provisioning. Atomic CAS alone establishes exclusion, not host-crash durability.
findings.requiredRemediation: Use explicit command-local fsync settings for loose objects and references with fsync method, establish any needed directory durability before dispatch/provision completion, fail closed on hardening failure, and test actual ordering/failure without real sources. Do not change global credentials/configuration.
findings.evidence: env MANPAGER=cat man git-config | col -b: core.fsync lines2593-2645; core.fsyncMethod lines2647-2656. git config --get core.fsync and core.fsyncMethod each yielded no configured value.
